Part 1 - Classes and Methods / ODFacet

GetContainingFacet

The GetContainingFacet method returns a reference to the containing facet of this facet. 
ODFacet GetContainingFacet ();
return value
A reference to the containing facet of this facet, or kODNULL if this facet has no containing facet.
